costs.scope: Observed incremental trial costs with existing Source/teacher caches; not standalone end-to-end inference latency

B_history_comparison.interpretation: Actual saved OPD and fixed-KD targets use the same frozen immediate-teacher reference continuation rule conditioned on different incoming histories. The rule does not use student-weight continuation. This is not an isolated causal memory ablation; identical complete incoming states must have identical targets.

config.teacher_logits: A instantaneous r/.2; B exact Q4/.2; neither includes student prior
config.memory_write: omega=.2*c*u(selected); normalized convex memory; no forced observation reset
config.observation: native continuous cxcywh slot1 always retained, no IoU dedup; outside fixed Strong inactive readout stays ERef
config.geometry_source: native teacher box exclusively; no mask threshold component or bounding box

transform.fit: axiswise weighted least squares: scale=cov(x,y)/var(x); delta=mean_y-scale*mean_x
transform.unreliable: side invalid; no scale clipping, no translation-only fallback; fully off-image boxes invalid

config.reliability: same source-mask return-cycle soft Dice; observed r=1 is no-transport not correctness
config.link: same v0 occupancy*transported mask supports and fixed Source adjacent weights; no box-boundary generation
config.reference_policy: frozen_instantaneous_softmax((u+.25*link+.1*memorycos-.1G)/.2), no student prior or learned phi
config.return_reward: rho_t=active_t*(u+.25*link+.1*memorycos-.1G); no extra confidence multiplier inside return
config.return_definition: force current candidate, then exact expectation over up to three future discrete reference actions; sum undiscounted, no division byH, truncate atT
config.inactive_start: Q all zero and only E valid; active-start rollout traversing inactive uses rho0, advances previous E, no memory write
config.reference_gradients: all reference probabilities, branch memories, teacher distribution and incoming soft student histories differentiate in Direct
config.OPD: two current-student hard histories refreshed once each outer round; teacher/features fixed for up to10 inner steps
config.FixedKD: two teacher histories sampled once at initialization and fixed for all outer/inner fits
config.Direct: two full soft histories recomputed every inner step; same outer Gumbel pair reused within round; full available gradient

Identical incoming memory, previous action distribution and previous selected feature must give the same target. This comparison is not an isolated causal memory ablation. No new rollout or teacher feedback is generated.
